children: Empower India, a technology and digital infrastructure company, has executed an indicative, non-binding term sheet with Mark AB Capital Private to acquire the entire equity share capital of Valiance Engineers.

The proposed transaction will be structured as a 100 per cent non-cash share swap via the preferential allotment of fresh equity shares of Empower India, establishing Valiance Engineers as a wholly-owned subsidiary.

title: Empower India to acquire Valiance Engineers in all-equity transaction
